name: Tres Palacios Storage Lateral
researcher_notes: The EIA pipeline projects workbook released in August 2026 lists this project on the Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 528. It is a completed interstate lateral of 41.72 miles and 36 inches, with 2,500 MMcf/d of added capacity. The project is under FERC docket CP07-90 and entered service in October 2008. The sponsor is listed as NGS Investments LLC. It is in Texas and appears to serve the Tres Palacios gas storage field in Matagorda County, but EIA does not name the endpoints. The roster has no row for it. The only close match is P7835 Cougar Lateral, which is a different proposed 55 mile line that starts at the same storage field. At 41.72 miles it is above the 25 km minimum for new pipe. Only one source was found, which is EIA. No FERC order, Federal Register notice or operator document could be checked because web search was unavailable in this run. Endpoints, route and the exact owner of record are not confirmed. The owner name is as EIA spells it. The operating company may be Tres Palacios Gas Storage LLC, which is unconfirmed. Capacity is the added capacity from EIA. No route research was done, so RouteType is left blank. A person should pair this with the FERC order for CP07-90 before applying.
